2608.23098.title: Jiuge-Tuiqiao: An Interpretable Human-AI System for Classical Chinese Poetry Refinement
2608.23098.paper_summary: Classical Chinese poetry composition has long valued Tuiqiao, the iterative refinement of words, imagery, and prosody. However, many current AI poetry systems follow a one-shot generation paradigm, which reduces users to prompt providers and weakens their creative agency. We present Jiuge-Tuiqiao, an interactive human-AI collaborative system for classical Chinese poetry composition. The system is designed around a triadic model: user-driven control, ancient-guided evidence, and AI-assisted generation. Users can lock characters or lines, receive real-time prosody feedback, and obtain interpretable refinement suggestions grounded in high-frequency collocations, PPL-ranked classical lines, and structured knowledge extracted from classical encyclopedias. This design turns AI from an autonomous generator into a background assistant that supports the user's own process of poetic refinement. Preliminary experiments and user feedback suggest that Jiuge-Tuiqiao improves controllability, interpretability, and user engagement in classical poetry composition.
2608.23098.paper_summary_zh: 古典中文詩詞創作長期以來重視推敲，即對詞語、意象和韻律的反覆精煉。<lb/>然而，許多當前的AI詩詞系統遵循一次性生成的範式，這使得用戶僅僅成為提示提供者，削弱了他們的創造性主動性。<lb/>我們提出了九歌-推敲，一個互動的人機協作系統，用於古典中文詩詞創作。<lb/>該系統圍繞三元模型設計：用戶驅動的控制、古代引導的證據和AI輔助的生成。<lb/>用戶可以鎖定字詞或行句，獲得實時的韻律反饋，並獲得基於高頻搭配、PPL排名的古典詩句和從古典百科全書中提取的結構化知識的可解釋的精煉建議。<lb/>這一設計將AI從一個自主生成器轉變為一個背景助手，支持用戶自身的詩詞推敲過程。<lb/>初步實驗和用戶反饋表明，九歌-推敲在古典詩詞創作中提高了可控性、可解釋性和用戶參與度。
